title: College websites
summary: What iKollege, Workflow, the academic website, fee portal and Moodle are for.

posts.md:
Several official College portals are used throughout your academic journey. Each portal serves a different purpose, from hostel management to academics and fee payments.

## iKollege

**Website:** https://ikollege.iitm.ac.in/iitmhostel/login

The **iKollege** portal is primarily used for hostel, mess, accommodation, and student services.

## Mess Services

- Register or update mess preferences.
- Purchase mess coupons.
- Apply for mess rebates.
- Request sick food.

## Accommodation & Rooms

- Apply for hostel accommodation.
- Submit room vacating forms.
- Book guest rooms.
- View room inventory.

## Financials & Account Management

- View student ledger.
- Check food court transaction history.
- Update student biodata.
- Change roll number.
- Reset RFID card PIN.

## Events & Support

- Purchase tickets or coupons for Hostel Night, Pro Shows, and merchandise.
- Raise and track hostel or mess complaints.

## Workflow

**Website:** https://workflow.iitm.ac.in/student/Authenticate.aspx

> ** Note:** Workflow currently works only on **Mozilla Firefox**. It does **not** work on **Google Chrome** or **Safari**.

Workflow is the primary academic portal used throughout your degree.

You can use Workflow to:

- Register for semester courses.
- Add or drop courses.
- Check grades.
- View scholarship details.
- Apply for reimbursements.
- Request supplementary or makeup examinations.
- Update bank account details.
- Raise course-related support tickets.
- Apply for grade improvement.

## Academic Website

**Website:** https://academic.iitm.ac.in/

The **Academic Website** provides detailed academic information and official documents.

You can:

- View course details, syllabus, and recommended textbooks.
- Browse all courses offered in a semester.
- Check the course instructor.
- View course credits.
- Find classroom allocations.
- Check course slots and timetable.
- View grades.

It also hosts important academic documents, including:

- Academic Calendar
- Academic Curriculum
- Academic Services
- Fees
- Financial Support
- Ordinances & Regulations
- Quiz & End Semester Examination Information
- Research Process
- Timetable

## Fee Portal

**Website:** https://fees.iitm.ac.in/nav/fee

The **Fee Portal** is used to pay:

- Institute Fees
- Mess Fees

## Moodle

**Website:** https://courses.iitm.ac.in/

**Moodle** is IIT Madras' **Learning Management System (LMS)**, where instructors share all course-related information and learning resources.

You can use Moodle to:

- Access lecture notes and presentation slides shared by professors.
- View the complete course structure and syllabus.
- Check important announcements, quiz schedules, assignment deadlines, and exam dates.
- Download course materials and reference resources.
- Stay updated with all official course-related communication from instructors.

For most courses, Moodle serves as the primary platform through which professors communicate important academic information throughout the semester.
